## 1. Export a summary .csv file showing all available studies

```{r}
##########################################################################################
#################################### Thomas and Allison's Code ###########################
##########################################################################################

compadre <- cdb_fetch("compadre") ## fetch the Compadre database from compadre-db.org
compadre_mp <- compadre[which(compadre$NumberPopulations>1),]  ## filter for multi-population studies
compadre_mp <- compadre[complete.cases(compadre@data[, c("Lat", "Lon")]) & 
                            compadre@data$MatrixComposite %in% "Individual" & ## Exclude the pooled matrices
                            compadre@data$MatrixTreatment %in% "Unmanipulated" & 
                            compadre@data$NumberPopulations > 1 & 
                            compadre@data$OrganismType != "Algae", ]
## Filter results to keep one example from each unique publication
unique_compadre_mp <- compadre_mp[
    which(!duplicated(paste(compadre_mp$Authors, compadre_mp$Journal,compadre_mp$YearPublication)))]

unique_compadre_mp_df <- as.data.frame(unique_compadre_mp)
subset_df <- unique_compadre_mp_df[, c("Authors", "Journal", "YearPublication", "DOI_ISBN")]

## Export
write.csv(subset_df, file = "processed data/01_Compadre matrices/unique_compadre_mp.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## 2. Make array
#### 2.1.1 Make matrix array
```{r}
## Check NAs
# any(is.na(unique_compadre_mp_df$YearPublication))
# any(is.na(unique_compadre_mp_df$Journal))    ## NA under journal
# any(is.na(unique_compadre_mp_df$Authors))

matrices_compadre <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(unique_compadre_mp_df)) {
 
  Authors <- unique_compadre_mp_df$Authors[i]
  Journal <- ifelse(is.na(unique_compadre_mp_df$Journal[i]),unique_compadre_mp_df$SourceType[i], unique_compadre_mp_df$Journal[i])   ### Make sure to include other source types that did not have a Journal source.
  YearPub <- unique_compadre_mp_df$YearPublication[i]
  if (any(is.na(c(Authors, Journal, YearPub)))){stop("Issues with study names:", i)}
  
  Matrices_index <- if (Journal %in% c("Thesis","Book Chapter","Report")){which(compadre_mp$Authors==Authors & compadre_mp$YearPublication==YearPub)
    } else {which(compadre_mp$Authors==Authors & compadre_mp$Journal==Journal & compadre_mp$YearPublication==YearPub)}  
    
  Matrix_list_i <- list()
  
  for (ii in 1:length(Matrices_index)) {
    idx <- Matrices_index[ii]
    Pop_names <- compadre_mp@data$MatrixPopulation[idx]
    Pop_syear <- compadre_mp@data$MatrixStartYear[idx]
    Pop_eyear <- compadre_mp@data$MatrixEndYear[idx]
    List_name <- paste0(Pop_names,"_",Pop_syear,"-",Pop_eyear)
    
    Matrix_list_i[[ii]] <- compadre_mp@data$mat[[idx]]@matA
    names(Matrix_list_i)[[ii]] <- List_name}
  
  
  ## Study name
  Authors_split <- strsplit(Authors, "; ")[[1]]
  Authors_i <- if (length(Authors_split) > 2) {
  paste0(Authors_split[1], " et al.")} else if (length(Authors_split) == 2) {
  paste(Authors_split[1], "&", Authors_split[2])
    } else {Authors}
  Author_year_i <- paste0(Authors_i, ", ", YearPub)
  
  matrices_compadre[[i]] <- Matrix_list_i
  names(matrices_compadre)[i] <- Author_year_i
}



```

#### 2.2.1 Extra info for each matrix
```{r}
## 
# Info_cols <- colnames(unique_compadre_mp_df)
Info_cols <- c("List name", "MatrixID", "SpeciesAuthor", "Population", "Latitude", "Longitude", "Observations", "DOI", "Matrixstartyear")

## Create a list of study info
Info_list <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(unique_compadre_mp_df)) {
 
  Authors <- unique_compadre_mp_df$Authors[i]
  Journal <- ifelse(is.na(unique_compadre_mp_df$Journal[i]),unique_compadre_mp_df$SourceType[i], unique_compadre_mp_df$Journal[i])   ### Make sure to include other source types that did not have a Journal source.
  YearPub <- unique_compadre_mp_df$YearPublication[i]
  if (any(is.na(c(Authors, Journal, YearPub)))){stop("Issues with study names:", i)}
  
  Matrices_index <- if (Journal %in% c("Thesis","Book Chapter","Report")){which(compadre_mp$Authors==Authors & compadre_mp$YearPublication==YearPub)
  } else {which(compadre_mp$Authors==Authors & compadre_mp$Journal==Journal & compadre_mp$YearPublication==YearPub)}  
  
    #######################################################################
  
  
  Info_df_i <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = length(Info_cols), nrow = 0, dimnames = list(NULL, Info_cols)))
  
  for (ii in 1:length(Matrices_index)) {
    idx <- Matrices_index[ii]
    
    MID_ii <- compadre_mp@data$MatrixID[idx]
    Species_ii <- compadre_mp@data$SpeciesAuthor[idx]
    Pop_ii <- compadre_mp@data$MatrixPopulation[idx]
    Lat_ii <- compadre_mp@data$Lat[idx]
    Lon_ii <- compadre_mp@data$Lon[idx]
    Observations_ii <- compadre_mp@data$Observations[idx]
    DOI_ii <- compadre_mp@data$DOI_ISBN[idx]
    Matrixstartyear_ii <- compadre_mp@data$MatrixStartYear[idx]
    
    
    Pop_names <- compadre_mp@data$MatrixPopulation[idx]
    Pop_syear <- compadre_mp@data$MatrixStartYear[idx]
    Pop_eyear <- compadre_mp@data$MatrixEndYear[idx]
    List_name <- paste0(Pop_names,"_",Pop_syear,"-",Pop_eyear) 
    
    
    values_ii <- c(List_name,MID_ii,Species_ii,Pop_ii,Lat_ii,Lon_ii,Observations_ii,DOI_ii,Matrixstartyear_ii)
    Info_df_i[ii,] <- values_ii
  }
  
  Authors_split <- strsplit(Authors, "; ")[[1]]
  Authors_i <- if (length(Authors_split) > 2) {
  paste0(Authors_split[1], " et al.")} else if (length(Authors_split) == 2) {
  paste(Authors_split[1], "&", Authors_split[2])
    } else {Authors}
  Author_year_i <- paste0(Authors_i, ", ", YearPub)
  
  Info_list[[i]] <- Info_df_i
  names(Info_list)[i] <- Author_year_i
  
}

### export this list as excel
writexl::write_xlsx(Info_list, path = file.path("F:/PhD/Sensitivity meta analysis/Compadre matrix meta data examples/Meta data for queried studies.xlsx"), col_names = TRUE)


```

###### 2.2.2 Visual checks of coords
```{r}
### Filter for studies that have populations sharing the same coordinates

single_location <- character()

for (i in 1:length(Info_list)) {

  Lat_unique <- unique(Info_list[[i]]$Latitude)
  Lon_unique <- unique(Info_list[[i]]$Longitude)

  if (length(unique(Info_list[[i]]$SpeciesAuthor)) == 1) {
    if (length(Lat_unique) == 1 & length(Lon_unique) == 1) {
      single_location <- c(single_location, names(Info_list)[i])
    }
  }

  if (length(unique(Info_list[[i]]$SpeciesAuthor)) > 1) {
    if (length(Lat_unique) <= length(unique(Info_list[[i]]$SpeciesAuthor)) &
        length(Lon_unique) <= length(unique(Info_list[[i]]$SpeciesAuthor))) {
      single_location <- c(single_location, names(Info_list)[i])
    }
  }
}

```
Many studies contained no spatial replications: 1) one species, populations share the same coordinates, or 2) multiple species, each species containing populations that share the same coordinates, namely, num(species)>=num(spatially distinct populations).
